footnote_text: Represents shares of common stock of the Issuer surrendered to the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of 5,833 shares of restricted stock granted to the reporting person on January 23, 2025. The terms of the forfeiture were approved in advance by the Issuer's Board of Directors, and the transaction is exempt from Section 16(b), pursuant to Rule 16b-3(e).  No shares were issued or sold in this transaction. The per-share value assigned to the shares surrendered reflects the price per share on the date on which the shares vested as reported on the NYSE American.

Shares sold in a privately negotiated transaction to J PED, LLC ("J PED") pursuant to a Stock Purchase Agreement dated November 23, 2026. J PED is wholly owned and controlled by Juniper Capital IV, L.P., an investment fund. Edward Geiser, a member of the Board of Directors of the Issuer designated by affiliates of Juniper Capital Advisors, L.P., is the indirect, sole owner of the general partner of Juniper Capital IV, L.P. and may be deemed to beneficially own the shares held by J PED.
